reason: Both correctly reassure that Eco 40-60 is deliberately long, rule out a fault, and avoid recommending a return or part. Conversation 1 draws a cleaner fault boundary (only if the cycle never completes, loops, or shows a code), confirms the key unknowns that it finishes and that Cottons 40 runs at a normal shorter time, and points to Cottons 40 as the practical shorter alternative, though it misses the TimeManager option. Conversation 2 offers a flawed heuristic ('if the laundry comes out warm the heater is fine') that would mislead on a low-temperature eco cycle with cold rinses, never checks other programmes, and gives the homeowner no practical choice when time matters.
